nodes.name: INT | Slack Manager Request
nodes.notes:
COMPONENT ID
INT-005

NODE NAME
INT | Slack Manager Request

NODE TYPE
Slack Trigger

PURPOSE
Accept governed Revenue Intelligence requests when the Lumora Slack app is explicitly mentioned in the trusted development reporting channel.

SETTINGS
Event = app_mention
Channel ID = C0BUK581XRN
Channel = lumora-revint-reports-dev
Resolve IDs = false

SECURITY BOUNDARY
- The trigger is restricted to the trusted Lumora development reporting channel.
- A Slack mention is intake only; it grants no KPI, SQL, database, or destination authority.
- Slack request text is normalized before entering REVINT-01.
- The normalization node independently enforces the trusted channel ID before handoff.
- The existing deterministic governance and read-only PostgreSQL boundary remain authoritative.
- Select an existing Slack API credential in n8n after import. Store the token and Slack signing secret only in n8n Credentials.

TEST
After Slack Event Subscriptions can reach the n8n HTTPS webhook, mention the Lumora app in lumora-revint-reports-dev with a supported reporting question.

nodes.name: CTX | Normalize Slack Request
nodes.notes:
COMPONENT ID
CTX-005

PURPOSE
Normalizes a Slack app_mention event into the standard Revenue Intelligence request envelope.

OUTPUT
channel = slack
requester_id = Slack user ID
requester_name = available Slack username or requester ID
question = message text with app mentions removed
source = slack_app_mention
received_at = ISO timestamp
environment = development
status = received

SECURITY BOUNDARY
- Enforces trusted channel ID C0BUK581XRN before handoff.
- Rejects bot-generated messages to reduce loop risk.
- Removes Slack mention markup before governance.
- Does not interpret KPI intent, authorize metrics, generate SQL, access PostgreSQL, or choose external destinations.
- Destination authority remains in the trusted Slack configuration inside REVINT-01.

TEST
A valid request should produce the same envelope shape as Form/API intake with channel = slack.

nodes.name: INT | Submit Governed Slack Request
nodes.notes:
COMPONENT ID
INT-005-SUBMIT

PURPOSE
Passes the normalized Slack request to the existing governed LUMORA-REVINT-01 Manager Request Orchestrator.

SECURITY BOUNDARY
- This gateway does not execute SQL.
- It does not bypass KPI validation or approved-query controls.
- It does not select the Slack destination from manager text.
- REVINT-01 remains the single authority for governance, read-only reporting execution, presentation, trusted destination resolution, delivery, and audit.

EXPECTED RESULT
A supported Slack request is governed by REVINT-01 and delivered through the existing trusted Slack adapter.
